photo_rules: Clean clinical product photography. Show the elongated mask AND the full 2 m / 6.8 ft tubing clearly. Surface fit/coverage proof (elongated shape, dimensions, adjustable nose clip + elastic band) to defuse sizing doubts. Show 'works with' context — home oxygen concentrator and nebulizer. Communicate latex-free, soft medical-grade PVC, pack of 5 individually wrapped. Hygienic white / soft-blue backgrounds; calm home-oxygen and clinical settings. No distressing ER/trauma imagery, no faces in distress.
no_gos: No scary or trauma medical imagery. No disease cure / treatment / prevention claims (this is an oxygen-delivery accessory, not a therapy). Do not imply it diagnoses or treats any condition. No 'FDA approved/cleared' wording unless verified. Keep it dignified and calm — never fear-based.
